## Notes

- **Publication:** objectstack. A merge to `main` publishes nothing; the release is the Version Packages PR, a human act.
- **Write channel:** the `fleet-write` relay, read back on every write.
- **Lesson recorded:** a `Regen-provenance:` pointer certifies only what the guard's own committed-tree test (`unexplainedPathsBetween`) accepts. A PR-touched, non-generated file that `main` also changed breaks the carry even when the merge was clean.
- **Lesson recorded:** a generated record that reads the ADR-0087 registries (`spec-changes.json`, the upgrade guide) goes stale when any step-18 writer lands, even with no textual conflict. CI checks the merge with the current `main`, so re-sync and regenerate before the review of record.
- **Receipts read through `6059883904`:** `domain:devx` seat 1's declaration of #22279 (`packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md`, prose only). No claim of this seat holds that file, so there is no objection.
